# Bringing TRIP back

> The TRIP Resurgence project aims to rescue an old forgotten IETF protocol called TRIP (Telephone Routing over IP) that was imagined by the designers of SIP, the VoIP protocol.

- [Bringing TRIP back](https://tripresurgence.org/index.md): Bringing TRIP back
- [The TRIP Protocol](https://tripresurgence.org/trip/trip.md): The Telephony Routing over IP protocol, RFC 3219, is an application layer policy-based dynamic routing protocol for telephone prefixes very similar to how BGP is for network prefixes.
- [tripd](https://tripresurgence.org/tripd/tripd.md): tripd is the TRIP Resurgence Internet Telephony Routing Daemon, an implementation of a TRIP Location Server.
- [The TRIP Resurgence Network](https://tripresurgence.org/net/net.md): The TRIP Resurgence Telephony Network will be an experimental community-ran testbed for the purposes of deploying, testing and characterising the TRIP protocol and the implementation of the TRIP Routing Daemon.

## The TRIP Protocol

- [TRIP: The Untold Battle for Telephone Routing in the Internet Age](https://tripresurgence.org/trip/history.md): Authors: arf20, Amdaith

## tripd

- [Configuration](https://tripresurgence.org/tripd/configuration.md): An example configuration is provided in the repo root as tripd.conf
